Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEVELS/NAV (observed): level select shows 1-1,1-2,1-3 checked; overall 1.5%. 1-3 sublevels 1-3-1..1-3-5; dots filled for 1-3-1..1-3-4 (solved), 1-3-5 never. Right triangle (0.963,0.468) advances sublevel; left triangle ~(0.045-0.055,0.468) backs (first click often inert, repeat with small x shift). Bottom pill (0.5,~0.91), top-right icon (.888,.07) and star (0.955,0.497) were inert. No completion banner/score/dots ever appeared for 1-3-5 despite two full strokes.

SOLVED-BOARD EVIDENCE (screenshots, not game text): solved boards show ~3 green dots beneath the board and a drawn solution. 1-3-2: ring-circle start→▼→solid■ end; 1-3-3: ring-circle→blank→▼→▼→■; 1-3-4 5x5: solid■ start→row1▼→down→row3 west through ▼▼▼▼→down→row5 ▼→ring-circle end. Template: one non-repeating stroke visiting every ▼ (and blanks), never stepping on hollow ▲, ending at the framed terminal. Which glyph is "framed start" in 1-3-5 is a guess.

GRID COORDS (observed): cols c1=.337 c2=.377 c3=.418 c4=.459 c5=.499 c6=.539 c7=.580 c8=.620 c9=.660; rows r1=.208 r2=.286 r3=.357 r4=.432 r5=.506 r6=.581 r7=.654 r8=.729 r9=.803. Step ≈52px horizontal, ≈55px vertical (c1≈x431, c9≈x848, r1≈y154). x≈.85 off-grid.

CONTROLS (observed): plain click does not start a path. After reset the first drag is swallowed; repeating the identical 3-cell drag from (0.337,0.214) to (0.337,0.358) (~1s) starts the trail. 1-cell and 4-cell drags failed to start. During trail, one step = ±52px dx / ±52-55px dy over 0.5-0.8s; longer sweeps (104/156/208) work and move multiple cells. Clicking ●r1c1 mid-trail is sometimes inert; repeated clicks reset to clean board. Clicks on mid-path, □, grid, pill are inert. Head position often ambiguous between near-identical frames — verify with an extra 1-cell step. No submit mechanism identified.

TRAIL MECHANICS (observed): moving back onto own trail erases fills of abandoned cells (○r1c9 re-hollowed; hollow ▲ reappeared). Fill persists only on the current stroke. Glyphs fill on entry, but some ▼ crossed inside long sweeps stayed pale (r5c7 once), while r5c7 later filled on entry and r2c7 filled only after re-entry. UNRESOLVED whether long sweeps skip collection or direction matters.

1-3-5 CLEAN MAP (consensus): ●-in-square r1c1 = start; hollow ○r1c9 (top-right, via r1c8); hollow □r9c9 (bottom-right, via row 9). ▼ (8, latest reading): r2c7, r4c2, r4c8, r4c9, r5c1, r5c7, r5c8, r7c2 (earlier counts said 7, excluding r5c8; r5c8 did fill when entered from the west). Hollow ▲: rows1-2 c2-c6; r2c8,r2c9; r4c3-c7; r5c2; r5c9; r6c1,c4-c9; r7c1,c3-c6; r8c1,c7,c8; r9c1-c5. Blank corridors: r3c1-c3, r3c7-c9, r1c7-r1c8, r5c3-c6, r6c2-c3, r7c7-c9, r8c2-c6, r8c9, r9c6-c8.

▲ MECHANICS (observed): hollow ▲ enterable from below and sideways; downward entry illegal (r2c9, r4c7 earlier). Not simple walls. Hollow □r9c9 fills on entry from the west and the stroke CAN continue past it north to r8c9 — □ does not stop or submit. ○r1c9 fills when entered; stroke ends there.

FAILED ATTEMPTS (observed): ●→□ bottom corridor skipping ▼; ●→○ only; c9 descent through ▲; lower route with most ▼ but ○ unvisited; route entering □ from above; ending at □ by click; two complete strokes ending at ○ with nearly all ▼ filled but no credit (once r5c7/r5c8 unfilled, once r4c8 pale). All UI-button presses inert.

FULL ROUTE EXECUTED (observed working, no credit yet): ●r1c1 ↓r2c1 ↓r3c1 →r3c2 ↓▼r4c2 ←r4c1 ↓▼r5c1 →▲r5c2 ↓r6c2 ↓▼r7c2 ↓r8c2 →r8c3→c4→c5→c6 ↑▲r7c6 ↑▲r6c6 ↑r5c6 →▼r5c7 →▼r5c8 ↑▼r4c8 →▼r4c9 ↑r3c9 ←r3c8 ←r3c7 ↑▼r2c7 ↑r1c7 →r1c8 →○r1c9. Variant also tried: r8c6→r8c9 ↑r7c9 ↑▲r6c9 ↑▲r5c9 ↑▼r4c9; and r7c9→r7c8→r7c7 ↑▲r6c7 ↑▼r5c7.

UNRESOLVED HYPOTHESES: is ○ or □ the true terminal (solved-board precedent leans ○, but □ fills on entry and is skippable); must every ▼ be genuinely filled; does ▲ traversal invalidate the stroke; does fill require entry direction or single-step landing; is backtracking itself disallowed. Pale/outline glyphs may simply be uncollected.

ACTIVE GOAL: earn 1-3-5 credit. Latest state: stroke completed to ○ with all ▼ dark except pale r4c8, no dots; then clicked ●r1c1 twice to reset (first click was swallowed). Next attempt should use single 52px steps throughout and aim to fill r4c8 and r2c7 in order, then finish at ○; if still no credit, test ending at □ instead or verify dots on level select.
